components.description: Paid leave ('continuation pay') at the base salary the faculty member would otherwise receive, for up to 60 calendar days in an academic year, for any FMLA-qualifying condition, including birth or care for a newborn and adoption or foster placement; for 9-month faculty who do not accrue sick leave.
components.mechanism_note: R17: employer pay for an FMLA-qualifying absence (here up to 60 calendar days) counts as employer-paid leave for both parents. Not V1 (not childbirth-specific); not a generic sick plan: the policy itself grants paid leave for every FMLA event, parental ones included.
components.faculty_group_note: faculty with academic year (9-month) appointments (POL 05.30.01 §2.1); Audience: Faculty; fiscal-year (12-month) faculty, who accrue sick leave, are outside the policy (§2.2)
components.eligible_parent_wording: birth or care for a newborn; placement of or care for an adopted or foster child (no role words)
components.service_requirement: academic-year appointment, no sick-leave accrual, eligible for TSERS or the Optional Retirement Plan (UNC 300.2.11: continuing faculty employed at least 75 percent of full-time); no length of service stated
components.entitlement_note: 'are entitled to continuation pay'. The request and provisional approval (§4.1–4.3) check the qualifying condition; a denial must state its reasons and may be appealed, so the approval does not decide whether the benefit exists.
components.duration_note: Up to 60 calendar days within an academic year (R11b: 7 per week, about 8.6 weeks); paid for the days of absence needed when fewer than 60 (§3.4); does not accumulate or carry over (§3.6). Faculty who changed from 12- to 9-month status first exhaust sick leave accrued while on 12-month status, then use continuation pay for the remainder of the 60 days (§3.5).
components.pay_fraction: any base salary they would otherwise receive
components.relief_note: A leave with substitute personnel for its duration; relief by duty not stated (R9).
components.time_window: within an academic year; not applicable from May 16 through August 15
components.notice: leave request form and Health Care Provider Certification form [if required] to the University Leave Administrator; must notify department head and/or dean in writing if not returning as planned
components.medical_certification_note: Health Care Provider Certification form [if required]
components.return_obligation: unused continuation pay is not paid out on resignation, separation or retirement

sequence.note: R3b: the alternative assignments run for the remainder of the semester in which the leave ends; the leave lies within that semester

components.mechanism_note: Income replacement after continuation pay ends; recorded like a long-term disability plan, without a duration (schema §2): the documents give no length or childbirth period.
components.faculty_group_note: faculty member (POL 05.30.01); plan 'provided to state employees'
components.entitlement_note: 'may be eligible for disability benefits'; information on how to apply is made available. The plan's terms are not saved; eligibility under them is coded as on request (V2).
components.time_window: after continuation pay is exhausted; absence anticipated to exceed sixty (60) calendar days

sequence.note: continuation pay 'must be exhausted prior to receiving benefits'

notes: Governing document: POL 05.30.01 (last revised 2010-02-19), in force on 2018-02-27; REG 05.20.31 as revised 2018-01-23 governs the tenure clock; UNC 300.2.11 (amended 2007) is the system mandate that POL 05.30.01 implements and supplies the 75-percent eligibility gloss. No collective agreement (faculty not unionised per the version note).

The member described (U8): a 9-month tenure-stream faculty member with two years of service, in TSERS or ORP. Path for faculty who moved from 12- to 9-month status (exhaust accrued sick leave first, §3.5) is recorded as a flag on c1. Fiscal-year (12-month) faculty are outside POL 05.30.01 and use accrued sick leave (c10, faculty_group named).

Birth parent chain: continuation pay up to 60 calendar days (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks alongside from the start (c3, concurrent_with c1) -> DIPNC salary continuation and voluntary supplemental disability once continuation pay is exhausted (c8, c9, consecutive_after c1, no length); with discretionary alternative assignments for the balance of the semester containing the leave (c2; c1 within c2).

Non-birth parent chain: continuation pay up to 60 calendar days (c1), with FMLA alongside (c3) -> NC Family Illness Leave Act up to 52 weeks for a spouse's serious illness (c4, consecutive_after c3, 'extension'); with discretionary alternative assignments for the balance of the semester containing the leave (c2).

Tenure clock: automatic one-year extension for a new child (c5) and for 60+ days of FML for other reasons (c6), at most two automatic extensions; other extensions for compelling circumstances, an open list, are discretionary and general-purpose (c7).

Cited but not saved: UNC POL Manual 300.2.11 [G] Guidelines on Serious Illness and Disability Leave for Faculty; NCSU Family Medical Leave; Disability Income Plan of North Carolina; Supplemental Disability Plans; North Carolina Family Illness Leave Act; NCSU POL05.20.01 Appointment, Reappointment, Promotion and Permanent Tenure; NCSU POL01.05.01 BOT Bylaws; NCSU REG 05.20.04 Post Tenure Review; NCSU REG01.25.09 Protected Health Information; NCSU POL04.25.05 Equal Opportunity; Request for Tenure Clock Extension Form; RPT Review Timeline Information; College RPT Liaisons; leave request form; Health Care Provider Certification form; Notification of 60 days Approved Family Leave form; Task Force on Serious Illness and Disability Policies for Faculty (March 2003).
